convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iCCI, iMA). Simple crossover entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP and fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh libraries, no grid/martingale, no multi-timeframe logic.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: EA applies digit adjustment by multiplying SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001, storing adjusted values in RealSL and RealTP. Opposite signal reversal logic: on a long signal, existing short is closed first; on a short signal, existing long is closed first. Uses previous bar values (shift 1) for crossover detection. CCI indicator handle is created with iCCI, and a secondary iMA is applied on the CCI indicator data via iCustom indicator pattern using PRICE_CLOSE on the CCI handle.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. CCI is available in ta-lib or pandas-ta. The MA-of-CCI requires computing CCI first then applying SMA on top. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. New bar detection can use bar timestamp comparison. Signal uses previous completed bar (shift=1) for crossover check, ensuring no repainting. Position gate closes opposite side before entry—implement as close-then-open sequence.
